posts.text:
It’s unjust to tax law-abiding citizens & see that money funneled to pay lawbreakers who are defrauding Medicaid. We will investigate & prosecute aggressively to end the racket.

Video

Young people are skeptical of the American Dream - home ownership out of reach, the cost of a college degree skyrocketing, & the value of that degree declining for so many. We’re going to turn that around in Ohio soon.

Video

Ending waste, fraud, and abuse in Medicaid will require federal & state governments to work together to fix broken incentives & allow states to recapture the benefits of the savings. Ohio should lead the way. Good discussion today with CMS Administrator @DrOzCMS. More to come.

Ohio spends over $40BN on Medicaid every year & there are undoubtedly a large number of dollars going to people who shouldn’t be getting it. That’s unfair & it’s a moral issue. A top priority for my administration will be to recover those savings & return it to law-abiding Ohioans.

The first 6 months of 2027 in Ohio will be transformative. That includes aggressively prosecuting the waste, fraud, and abuse in Medicaid & returning that money back to law-abiding taxpayers in Ohio.

Video

Great to welcome my friend & 3-time Super Bowl champion Matt Light to Ohio for the Buckeye Blast. He’s a winner on & off the field: the Light Foundation is doing amazing work in helping young people gain useful skills & find purpose in their lives. We’ll do our part in Ohio. 💪🏼

I know the American Dream exists because I’ve lived it. And we’re going to revive it right here in Ohio.

Video

I met a number of high school students in Darke County & spoke to a young man enlisting in the Air Force next year. Turns out he was recruited by the same Marine Corps recruiter at St. X High School back when I graduated in 2003.

Video

The success of Ohio must include the success of our farmers in rural Ohio & I’m committed to making that happen.

Video
Happy Mother’s Day, to Apoorva and to every mom out there! ❤️

Congrats to Ohio State men’s tennis for another massive win over Illinois yesterday. Onwards to the NCAA quarterfinals next week! 🎾



Video

I believe in celebrating success, Amy Acton believes in villainizing it. Businesses will flee our state in droves if she comes anywhere near power & it will be an economic devastation of a kind our state has never seen.

Video

Slash income & property taxes. Bring standards back to public education. Produce more energy to bring down electric bills. We can do this.

Video

Ohio has no place for socialism, and Ohio’s government has no place for Amy Acton. She failed Ohio once & we won’t let her fail us again.

Video

My opponent stood in front of cameras with a white coat claiming the mantle of “science,” while failing to follow the actual science. It was unforgivable. Ohio families are still suffering because of it & they can’t afford to ever trust Dr. Lockdown again.

Video

The taxpayer is not a piggy bank to be bilked. We will comprehensively review Ohio’s $40BN+ Medicaid expenditures and aggressively prosecute illegal abuses of the program. That starts in early 2027 & we won’t hold back.

Video

We won’t apologize for enforcing the rule of law. I intend to thoroughly investigate & aggressively prosecute waste, fraud, & abuse in Medicaid and other government programs - and put that $$ back in the pockets of law-abiding Ohioans.

Video

It’s a shame that city leaders in my hometown of Cincinnati have declared it a “sanctuary city.” That’ll change when I’m in charge of Ohio. We’ll never condone violating the law, or else the people lose respect for the rule of law itself.

Video
TRUTH.
State of Excellence. 🇺🇸🇺🇸
A reporter asked me what are three of my core values. Here’s what I said.
We will always respect & back our veterans. 🇺🇸 🇺🇸
Just voted! See you tonight at the victory party, will livestream.
Lower costs, bigger paychecks, better schools
You’re the one.

Democrats like Amy Acton drone on about “educational inequality” while creating the very problem with her disastrous public school closures during COVID. She owes our kids an apology. Now it’s up to us to fix their mess & we will.
How to ACTUALLY make life affordable.
Republicans, we lost.
Game day in Columbus. Go Bucks!
What Columbus Day really means.
Just got to Montana. Quick 6-mile hike before the event. Will livestream around 9pm ET.
What’s an American?
